title: helenium fimbriatum
intro: Helenium fimbriatum, commonly known as Tawny Sneezeweed, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family, Asteraceae. It is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Helenium fimbriatum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and modulating the immune system.
